prompt.project_info: Create a soft clean full-body bedroom mirror selfie with coquette fashion styling.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult brunette woman with long dark hair in low twin-tails, middle part, soft glam makeup, black glasses resting on her head, small gold pendant and hoop earrings. prompt.composition_elements: Full-body mirror selfie with the subject kneeling safely on a white fluffy shag rug over light wood flooring, torso slightly angled, phone covering part of the face and left hand near the shoe. Include cream upholstered bed, white bedding, floral pillow, white wardrobe doors, round mirror, potted monstera, and curtains.
